title: EU to US Shoe Size Converter
primaryKeyword: EU to US Shoe Size Converter
metaDescription: Accurately convert European (EU) shoe sizes to US sizes for Men, Women, and Children with Paris point conversions and foot length tables.
directAnswer: To convert European (EU) shoe sizes to US sizes, subtract 33 from men's sizes (an EU 43 equals a US Men's 9.5-10) and subtract 31 from women's sizes (an EU 38 equals a US Women's 7.5). Because EU Paris points differ from US barleycorn steps, always verify millimeter foot length.

faq.question: What is an EU 42 in US shoe size?
faq.answer: An EU size 42 corresponds to approximately a US Men's 8.5 to 9, or a US Women's 10 to 10.5.

faq.question: What does an EU 38 convert to in US women's?
faq.answer: An EU size 38 is typically equivalent to a US Women's size 7.5, accommodating a foot length of approximately 24.0 cm.

faq.question: Why don't all European shoe brands have half sizes?
faq.answer: European sizes use Paris points (6.67 mm per full step), which are already smaller increments than US full sizes (8.46 mm), so many European brands only manufacture full sizes.
